## Description

Please include a summary of the change and which issue is fixed. Include relevant motivation and context.

Fixes #(issue)

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update / Spec / ADR

## How Has This Been Tested?

- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passed without errors
- [ ] `npm test` passed with 100% green tests
- [ ] `npm run build` completed successfully
- [ ] Manually verified with `./dist/bin/cli.js`

## Checklist:

- [ ] My code follows the zero-external-runtime-dependencies rule.
- [ ] My code follows the domain vocabulary in `GLOSSARY.md`.
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works.
- [ ] New and existing unit tests pass locally with my changes.
